BASS.NET wrapper licensing notice

Source:
- https://www.radio42.com/bass/bass_purchase.html
- https://www.radio42.com/bass/bass_register.html
Retrieved: 2026-02-21

The official license page (retrieved 2026-07-28) states that BASS.NET is
licensed by radio42, and that freeware, shareware, and commercial use have
different conditions. It also requires a separate BASS license and forbids
sharing a personal registration key:
https://radio42.com/bass/bass_purchase.html

This repository does not contain the exact 2.4.12.1 acquisition archive,
the formal LICENSE.rtf, or evidence identifying the licensee and registration
entitlement for the retained binary. This notice is therefore an inventory
aid, not proof of redistribution permission. Keep the dependency status
YELLOW and do not publish until the external entitlement evidence is recorded.

Bass.Net.dll is the managed wrapper and is separate from native BASS binaries.
Upstream pages indicate freeware use may be allowed for personal,
non-commercial, non-money-making software, under strict conditions.

Important:
- You must satisfy BASS.NET wrapper conditions.
- You must also satisfy native BASS licensing terms from un4seen.
- Do not treat this summary as a substitute for upstream legal text.
